budgetNote.shortfall: the bag lot of each phase -- CREDA's `LOTE_1`/`LOTE_2` -- is not reachable from this module; see `PHASE_ONE_NOT_SEARCHED` for the measurement
budgetNote.whyItMatters: the trial budget is fixed, so every dimension added divides the same 25 trials further. Phase 1 now spends 25 trials over 6 dimensions and phase 2 over 3, where they spent them over 5 and 1; a gap between two cells smaller than the variance between two searches of this budget is not a reading of the method

notSearched.LOTE_1: CREDA sweeps `[32, 64, 128, 256]` POINTS per step; the unit here is the BAG and there is no lot to choose. `harness.balanced_batches` yields exactly one bag per class per step -- it takes no lot argument and reads no `config.BAGS_PER_STEP` -- so the training lot in bags IS the class count. `config.BAGS_PER_STEP` divides the role length to get the STEP COUNT of an epoch, which is an epoch length and not a lot, so searching it would search a repetition field wearing another name. Making the lot searchable means giving `balanced_batches` a per-class count, which is the DIGIT benchmark's own batching and outside this toyset's surface. A range derived from the realized train count would be `(3, 6, 12, 24, 48)` -- one bag per class doubling to the whole 48-bag training role -- and it is written here rather than searched because nothing can consume it yet
